summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine share purchases by its directors and PDMRs under the company's Dividend Re-Investment Plan following the 2025 final dividend. The transactions occurred on May 27, 2026, on the London Stock Exchange at a price of GBP 11.38002 per share. This is a standard administrative disclosure under UK Market Abuse Regulation, not a special situation event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or any other special situation. The filing is a routine current report of insider share holdings and transactions.
